fixture.rounding: Each priced segment is quantized to 12 decimals before aggregation

limits: Small deterministic fixture, not a scale benchmark, concurrent-write test or changed-reference correction campaign
Local and deployed Gold share the tariff calculator; independent unit assertions verify rational boundary totals
The failed bounded attempt and explicit full recovery are retained; only the two successful replays are claimed metadata-stable
The access-probe batch was not processed as pipeline history
Main convergence measured before controlled data-plane destruction; bootstrap convergence measured afterwards
privacy: Reviewed synthetic counts, fingerprints and checks only; account/resource pointers, credentials, state, plans, raw query rows and logs remain private

reference_replay_fix.fix: Select and cache only new keys or strictly higher versions; skip MERGE when count is zero
reference_replay_fix.observed_failure: Conditional MERGE rewrote unchanged reference snapshots; bounded Gold correctly refused before publication
reference_replay_fix.recovery: One reviewed normal reference S3 artifact update while all runs terminal, followed by explicit full Gold refresh; no permission or checkpoint edit
reference_replay_fix.retry: Original source and all four references rerun with a fresh bounded Gold generation; all eleven data metadata identities stable

scope: Late cumulative indexes, higher-version correction and genuine unchanged/older-source replays through dedicated ingestion, managed transformation and actual LF analyst identities
